 * @id py/unsafe-deserialization-pickle

import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call
where

    call = API::moduleImport("pickle").getMember(["load", "loads", "Unpickler"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("dill").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("marshal").getMember(["load", "loads"]).getACall() or
    call = API::moduleImport("shelve").getMember("open").getACall()
  )
select call, "Potentially unsafe deserialization operation that could execute arbitrary code."

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Regular Expression Denial of Service (ReDoS)
 * @description Regular expressions with exponential worst-case complexity can cause denial of service
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/redos
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-1333
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, Expr pattern
where
  (
    call = API::moduleImport("re").getMember(["compile", "match", "search", "findall", "finditer", "sub", "subn", "split"]).getACall() and
    pattern = call.getArg(0).asExpr()
  ) and
  exists(string s | 
    s = pattern.(StrConst).getText() and
    (
      // Nested quantifiers
      s.regexpMatch(".*\\([^)]*[*+][^)]*\\)[*+].*") or
      // Alternation with overlapping patterns
      s.regexpMatch(".*(\\||\\[)[^|\\]]*\\+[^|\\]]*\\+.*") or
      // Multiple consecutive quantifiers
      s.regexpMatch(".*[*+]{2,}.*")
    )
  )
select call, "Regular expression may be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks due to complex quantifiers."
findings.hypothesis: Check for regular expressions with potentially exponential complexity that could lead to ReDoS attacks

message.text: Regular expression may be vulnerable to ReDoS attacks due to complex quantifiers.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Hardcoded credentials
 * @description Hardcoded passwords or secrets in source code
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/hardcoded-credentials
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-798
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Assign assign, StrConst str
where
  (
    assign.getATarget().(Name).getId().toLowerCase().matches(["%password%", "%passwd%", "%secret%", "%api_key%", "%apikey%", "%token%"]) and
    assign.getValue() = str and
    not str.getText() = "" and
    not str.getText().matches(["%<<%", "%>>%", "%{%", "%}%", "%(s)%", "%example%", "%test%", "%dummy%", "%fake%", "%placeholder%"])
  )
select assign, "Potential hardcoded credential: " + assign.getATarget().(Name).getId()
findings.hypothesis: Check for hardcoded passwords, API keys, or secrets in variable assignments

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name Security-sensitive assert statements
 * @description Assert statements used for security checks can be disabled with Python's -O flag
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity warning
 * @id py/unsafe-assert
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-703
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs

from Assert assert, Expr test
where
  test = assert.getTest() and
  (
    // Check for security-related assertions
    test.toString().toLowerCase().matches("%auth%") or
    test.toString().toLowerCase().matches("%password%") or
    test.toString().toLowerCase().matches("%token%") or
    test.toString().toLowerCase().matches("%secret%") or
    test.toString().toLowerCase().matches("%permission%") or
    test.toString().toLowerCase().matches("%admin%") or
    test.toString().toLowerCase().matches("%secure%")
  )
select assert, "Assert statement used for security check may be disabled in production with -O flag."
findings.hypothesis: Assert statements used for security checks can be disabled with Python's -O optimization flag, potentially bypassing security controls

message.text: Assert statement used for security check may be disabled in production with -O flag.

findings.codeql_raw_query:
/**
 * @name SQL injection via raw text execution
 * @description Executing SQL queries constructed from user input without proper parameterization
 * @kind problem
 * @problem.severity error
 * @id py/sql-injection-raw-text
 * @tags security
 *        external/cwe/cwe-089
 */

import python
import semmle.python.ApiGraphs
import semmle.python.dataflow.new.DataFlow

from DataFlow::CallCfgNode call, DataFlow::Node arg
where
  (
    // Looking for execute() calls with string concatenation or formatting
    call = API::moduleImport("sqlalchemy").getMember("text").getACall() or
    call.getFunction().asExpr().(Attribute).getName() = "execute"
  ) and
  arg = call.getArg(0) and
  (
    // Check if argument involves string operations that could be dangerous
    exists(BinaryExpr binop |
      binop = arg.asExpr() and
      binop.getOp() instanceof Add
    ) or
    exists(Call formatCall |
      formatCall = arg.asExpr() and
      formatCall.getFunc().(Attribute).getName() in ["format", "join"]
    )
  )
select call, "Potential SQL injection: SQL query constructed using string operations without parameterization."
findings.hypothesis: SQL injection through raw text execution with string concatenation or formatting
